summary: Full retest of Rentabilité CareerOS v2 (lines/revenue_real + catalog admin). 14/14 backend pytest tests pass covering auth, catalog shape (5 families seeded + 17 providers with 'used' flag), category CRUD + 409-when-has-providers, provider CRUD + audit (create/update/archive) + 409-when-used, month save math (theory=price×paid, adjustments signed by kind, expected=theory+adj, used=real||expected, gap_cad=real-theory, unexplained=real-expected, infra line gap in CAD via fx), recurrent providers auto-proposed (est_source='recurrent') while suspended/out-of-range are excluded, ops_cad+dev_cad=total_cad, operating_margin/net_margin, invest_cad from dev ponctuel lines, archived provider with saved line still appears, members list + 404, AI logging regression via /api/generate. Frontend admin login + Rentabilité tab + all required data-testid: 10 KPI cards (kpi-revenue/infra/ai/marketing/dev/total/op-margin/margin/active/paid) each with a *-nature badge, nature-legend, finance-answers, finance-revenue (rev-theory/rev-real present), finance-costs with 5 cost-family-* groups and 9 cost-line-*, margin-op, margin-net, finance-per-member, finance-projections. Catalog sheet opens with catalog-categories + catalog-providers; provider add via prov-add-btn → provider-form → prov-save works (TEST_uiprov visible in prov-row-*); prov-history-{id} shows provider-history panel; prov-archive-{id} archives (toast 'Fournisseur archivé'). Editor sheet opens; fin-revenue-real correctly pre-fills 300 for preview month 2026-10. Mobile 390px: scrollWidth=innerWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow). Preview DB restored (2026-10 revenue_real=300, rabais=20, 2 lines preserved; all TEST_ catalog entities deleted via API after test).

issues: fin-save button is positioned via sticky bottom-0 inside sm:max-w-xl Sheet; Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' when clicking at 1920×1080 without scrolling the sheet's internal scroll container. Visually fine for real users, but automated tests must JS-click or scroll the sheet. Minor — consider ensuring the sticky footer stays visible without needing internal scroll on short viewports.

Non-blocking console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is caused by the preview-env runtime instrumentation wrapping dynamic text in <span>, NOT by the app code itself. Will not reproduce in production builds.

action_items: (Optional, DX) In FinanceEditor, make the bottom action bar always visible (e.g., switch Sheet to flex column with footer outside overflow-y-auto) so e2e tooling doesn't need internal scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/careeros/finance.py (549 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold — splitting catalog CRUD vs summary/compute into separate modules would improve maintainability but is not urgent.
seed_catalog() migrates legacy platform_costs/ai_invoices → lines idempotently on each app start by scanning finance_months without 'lines' key — correct and safe.
_used_providers() correctly excludes rows that have both estimated and real as None (recurrent-auto-proposed rows are not persisted and therefore don't block delete) — matches spec.

_lines() correctly skips archived providers that have no saved line (so archived recurrent providers don't pollute the dashboard) and keeps them visible when a saved line exists — matches spec and verified in test_finance_preview_month_2026_10.
classify() nicely routes OpenRouter :free into openrouter_free bucket; invest_cad is derived from recurrence=='ponctuel' lines in dev family — matches spec.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_finance.py (rewritten for v2 schema: catalog shape, category/provider CRUD + 409 flows, provider audit, month save math incl. gap/unexplained, recurrent proposal rules, archived-with-line display, members, AI logging)
